name: B10-0435/2025 (ECR) – 10th anniversary of the detention of jailed Swedish publisher Gui Minhai in China
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 10th anniversary of the detention of jailed Swedish publisher Gui Minhai in China
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns China's detention of Gui Minhai, a Swedish-Hong Kong publisher jailed for 10 years, and asks China to release him, say where he is, and let him see doctors and Swedish officials. It also asks European Union countries to raise his case with China and consider sanctions on the officials responsible.

- No law changes; Parliament asks China to free Gui Minhai and reveal his whereabouts.
- Affects Gui Minhai, other Europeans jailed in China, and Chinese officials who could face sanctions.
- Next, European Union governments decide whether to raise the case and impose sanctions.
